title: Customer Persona Builder
prompt: Create detailed customer personas including demographics, psychographics, pain points, goals, and behaviors. Use personas to inform marketing and product decisions.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Baseline conversion metrics or historical performance
use_case_examples: Plan a targeted customer persona builder initiative with segment-specific messaging and conversion goals
Optimize current customer persona builder performance using experiment design and performance benchmarks
Prepare a customer persona builder execution pack with channel strategy, content hooks, and measurement plan
success_criteria: Plan includes clear audience targeting, offer, and channel rationale
Measurement framework defines baseline, target, and optimization loop
Customer persona builder recommendations are specific enough to execute this sprint
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
